lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: The gate is quiet. The memorial is by it now, and the militia drills there. Strange, the things a village remembers that it never lived.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: The gate is quiet. The square is not; that sentry watches all night. Do not tell me it was always there.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: The gate is quiet. Thank you.
